project_type: Ervisio plugin (ervisio-plugin-docker v2.2.0): sandboxed React/TypeScript frontend bundled with Vite; reaches the host only through manifest-declared commands, HTTP APIs and folders
build_system: npm + vite; plugin/manifest.json is partly generated by scripts/gen-manifest.mjs
test_framework: node:test (node --import ./test/register.mjs --test test/), files test/*.test.ts, SDK mocked with setSdk() from src/sdk.ts (see test/followups.test.ts, test/environments.test.ts)
verification_instructions: 1) node scripts/gen-manifest.mjs (regenerate) then node scripts/gen-manifest.mjs --check. 2) npm run typecheck. 3) npm test. 4) npm run build (may fail if @ervisio/plugin-sdk devDependency is not installed; report, do not hack around it).
snapshot_or_generated_files: plugin/manifest.json: the git-*, compose-*-git, stack-mark, container-redeploy, volume-* commands and all jobs are written by `node scripts/gen-manifest.mjs`; test/automation.test.ts runs `--check`. Never hand-edit those entries; edit gen-manifest.mjs and regenerate. Other manifest entries (files, http, stacks-init, compose-*) are hand-maintained in manifest.json.
setup_instructions: npm ci (or npm install). The SDK devDependency github:Ervisio/plugin-sdk#v0.2.0 may be missing from node_modules; tests import ../src/*.ts directly and mock the SDK.
environment_constraints: Windows host, PowerShell. In the planner session the shell tool failed with 'InitializeDefaultDrives ... FileSystem' errors under the OS sandbox; always pass cwd=d:\Projects\plugin-docker. No running Ervisio host: runtime behaviour of the daemon (root bridge HOME, file modes) cannot be tested, only documented behaviour.
contribution_requirements: Keep CHANGELOG.md updated (top 'Unreleased'/next section). i18n strings live in src/i18n/areas/*.ts with English and Italian blocks; add keys to both. Never use em dashes in written text.
key_patterns: Commands are built with cmd(name, description, argv, args, extra) in gen-manifest.mjs; priv = { admin: true, adminUnlessGroup: 'docker' }. Args need a whole-match pattern. {N} is substituted also inside an argv item (documented in Ervisio docs/api/plugins.md). Admin commands run on the root bridge (as root) unless the user is root or in the docker group; '~' folders in capabilities.files are always used with the user's own rights in the user's home; admin folders (/opt/stacks) follow the same identity rule as admin commands. plugins.writeFile creates new files 0644 and keeps the mode of an existing file; plugins.mkdir creates 0755. fsx in src/api/compose.ts wraps getSdk().files with filesEnv() (adds {env} for paired Ervisio servers). Errors from git go through explainGitError (src/api/gitMeta.ts, pure, unit-tested) and GitError (src/api/git.ts); UI shows t(e.key) plus detail.
directory_structure: src/api: data/SDK layer (git.ts, gitMeta.ts pure helpers, compose.ts fsx + stacks). src/views: React pages (GitStackPage.tsx = new Git stack form with Check button). src/i18n/areas: strings (en + it). scripts/gen-manifest.mjs: generator of git/job manifest entries. plugin/manifest.json: shipped manifest. test/: node:test suites.
